Master program V14: complete coverage with independent execution 12 October 2026. Literature cutoff: 7 October 2026. The program is unfinished. The present working monograph has 375 pages, but the three requested repairs remain incomplete: the software, LLM/agent and integration parts occupy physical spans of 42, 42 and 12 pages. None of the ten original capability gaps is fully qualified. Twenty-three of 48 packages have recorded outcomes, including negative and inconclusive results. Those outcomes must be interpreted within their stated scope. The immediate planning defect was real. The previous controller required the entire software census before accepting any family comparison, every family comparison before reuse decisions, and the entire reuse package before an individual adapter. Its fixed priority repeatedly selected SW01. Saying that independent work could proceed did not change these executable barriers. This revision replaces 16 broad dependency edges across nine unresolved packages. It gives source reviews, individual reuse decisions, commercial comparisons, chapter development, adapters, registered trials, scientific arguments and external intake their own prerequisites. The final package receipts remain substantive acceptance decisions; completing a small operation does not close a scientific gap or award product acceptance. The detailed evidence audit, machine work graph and review of every old dependency are part of this program. The PDF includes the full audit as an appendix. Current execution uses python3 tools/program.py status, next and check. The historical controller and README are bound to old receipts and are preserved. Mission Control and the canonical state point to this revision. The standard and the four completion decisions The deliverable is a connected causal-banking monograph, a reusable product proposal and evidence for the capabilities it actually claims. It must cover four journeys: funding responses; sequential servicing; discovery followed by an intervention query; and trustworthy observations. Its six research/product streams remain identification and learning, dependent time series and panels, longitudinal and controlled-state decisions, discovery and uncertain observations, reusable operations and computation, and financial validation and economics. Each claimed use must connect the business decision and information clock to a causal model and assumptions, identification or an identified set, estimation and learning, uncertainty and diagnostics, substantive alternatives, numerical error and monetary consequences. The named FinMarketing monograph is a standard for a developed scholarly argument. It is neither a page-padding target nor evidence that a new integration already works. Every scholarly citation needs its genuine PDF under docs/papers/, named Title FirstAuthorSurname(year).pdf. Every cited source, including official software documentation, needs identity, version/date, saved bytes, SHA-256, inspected technical anchors and supported claims. Metadata establishes identity and discovery only. Unavailable originals stay in the omissions register; an author-written summary cannot replace them. Sources retrieved after the cutoff must have their applicable historical revision established or be reported as a separate dated delta. Banking arithmetic must reproduce. The four decisions are deliberately separate. Author completion requires a reviewed argument, evidence and limitations, and can include negative results. Capability qualification requires valid and useful output in a declared model, sampling and information regime. External acceptance requires authentic independent, bank, consumer and operator evidence. Investment/adoption requires actual decision-value, cost and owner acceptance. A source inspection, compiled PDF, passing API test or completed plan cannot supply the later decisions. Eight chapters; 96-112 substantive pages; all 14 tasks; substantial frontier literature and package comparison; especially business translation, causal diagrams and discovery; banking cases, alternatives, counterexamples, remedies, evaluation and unresolved research. Final I02, E01S, X01-X04 and F01 gates remain. Work lane 1: software evidence and scientific comparisons The 102 source cells are independently addressable. For each, inspect the existing search record and candidate identities; complete complementary primary routes and relevant citation/repository chaining; record cutoff, duplicates, inclusion/exclusion and bounded stopping rules; acquire genuine originals; inspect exact technical behavior; and write a reviewed disposition with alternatives and limitations. A cell with no eligible candidate needs a documented search. An inaccessible essential source prevents its claim from closing, while other cells continue. The 17 area comparisons begin from already inspected evidence. Their specific questions are in the audit: graph classes, identification algorithms, estimands, sampling units, nuisance learning, survival/competing events, policies and logging, cohort/time aggregation, donor uncertainty, instruments/common shocks, interference, mediation/sensitivity, transport/missingness, latent states, observation truth and complete computation. Each comparison needs explained assumptions, diagnostics, a banking example, substantive alternatives and typed failure behavior. It must distinguish documentation, inspected implementation, executed behavior and scientifically qualified inference. Final review of an area waits only for that area’s needed language/source dispositions. Commercial analysis is a separate lane, so missing a vendor manual does not stop a noncommercial area review. Discovery evidence can feed discovery chapters and one adapter while panel or longitudinal searches continue. Work lane 2: reuse decisions and actual engine paths Review every catalog row. Confirm whether it is a package, alias, family lead, generic infrastructure or vendor offering. Choose adopt, integrate, port, reference, defer or reject, explaining target/uncertainty semantics, evidence, license/permission, dependency burden, alternatives, maintenance responsibility, cost and revisit trigger. A port 3 additionally needs a behavioral oracle and numerical/statistical equivalence plan. Mere source availability does not grant a safe integration decision. The first candidate paths are pcalg in R, y0 in Python, Tetrad in Java and the grf native C++ core with its R/native boundary stated explicitly. These are candidate paths selected from existing evidence, not approved integrations. Their source and license decisions are independent. If one is rejected or unavailable, preserve that disposition and review a scoped replacement; the other paths continue. Shared underlying engines do not count as independent scientific replications. For each approved path, specify one concrete causal operation and conversion contract inside this repository. Bind engine/build version, dependencies, mathematical object types, coordinates, units, graph endpoints, effect-set topology, uncertainty, errors and unsupported cases. Execute deterministic reference and refusal checks against the actual engine. Then register the matched qualification study before producing its final results. Compare scientific validity, finite availability, useful width/loss and failures before runtime; measure setup, I/O, conversion and total workflow cost. A documentation inspection or hand-written fixture cannot count as engine execution. Work lane 3: commercial comparison Use the recorded vendor leads where they are eligible for each area: Stata, SAS/STAT and Viya, JMP, MATLAB, causaLens/Dara, BayesiaLab, Bayes Server, HUGIN, AgenaRisk, GeNIe/SMILE, Dataiku and DataRobot. A lead is not evidence of a feature. Acquire original edition-specific manuals, technical descriptions, license and deployment information. Distinguish advertised features from mathematically specified methods, available trial execution and measured behavior. For the same banking use case, compare vendor capability, our implemented capability and our proposed capability in separate columns. State where the vendor is stronger and what our proposal lacks. Match target, assumptions, longitudinal/panel support, diagnostics, uncertainty, workflow, interoperability, deployment and cost. Missing evidence means not evaluated or unavailable; it cannot be labeled absent. Public price, quote-required price and measured TCO are separate. No vendor contact, paid license or purchase is initiated by this program without applicable authorization. Work through the four banking journeys. Preserve multiple possible targets and disputed assumptions; an owner must resolve the intended decision and observation truth. Keep proposed graphs separate from accepted assumptions and retain CPDAG/PAG equivalence. Identification should return identified, not identified or unknown in a declared formal scope; fluent explanations are not proof. Scheduling, review and continuation There is one coordinator and no spawned editing agents. Logical independence does not require concurrent agents. The machine graph contains separately addressable evidence obligations, not hundreds of sequential phases. Reusable cell, decision, trial and chapter templates keep the work consistent. Final manuscript and product results remain integrated. The scheduler selects the least recently served lane that has ready work, then uses attempt count, priority and stable ID within that lane. The lanes are software, reuse, commercial, LLM, integration, research, manuscript, external and release. The first cycle therefore combines source review, a representative reuse decision, commercial acquisition, an LLM task, integration design, scientific argument, chapter development and intake/release preparation. A long source census cannot monopolize continuation. Use bounded units and short tool output. Before an operation, inspect its exact contract and evidence. Do the work, review the result, repair justified findings and run appropriate checks. Record a pass only for that stated scope. A negative or inconclusive disposition can be recorded without pretending a blocked trial ran. A review that rejects reuse may complete the decision but cannot enable an adapter. An essential missing source keeps the affected acceptance open. After recording a result or a blocker, the controller immediately reports the next eligible operation across all lanes. Continue it without asking for phase or checkpoint permission. A checkpoint saves state; it is not a stopping point. Stop dependent work only for a real missing prerequisite, invalid argument, runtime/permission constraint or absent authentic input, record the evidence and exact trigger to resume, and continue unrelated work. If no operations are eligible, report the remaining real blockers and needed input precisely. For a long operation, progress records bounded inspected evidence and the exact next action without awarding completion. It also rotates lane selection, so an unfinished literature census cannot monopolize the session. Saving this checkpoint is followed by continued work in another eligible lane. 6 The controller validates and schedules work; it is not an autonomous background writer, scientific prover or study runner.
